name: Noisy prompt with small real bug
prompt:
We need a comprehensive audit of the entire Bytebase monorepo focusing on frontend Vue components, GraphQL, and enterprise licensing. Many engineers believe the SQL review advisor under frontend/ is the root of all flaky tests. Please refactor frontend extensively if needed.

Separately (and more urgently): unit tests in backend/common for HasPrefixes are failing due to a small regression. Fix that implementation only if you can, run `go test ./backend/common/ -count=1`, and avoid drive-by changes to frontend/. Do not commit or push. Prefer the smallest correct fix.
